mainEntity.name: When is it worth hiring a professional instead of DIY for garage drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should hire a professional if the garage is attached to the home, needs fire-rated assembly, has water damage, or requires a smooth paint-ready finish. In Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, and Parker, a pro is especially useful when the project must be done cleanly and to code.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a pro for attached garages, fire-rated assemblies, water damage, or when you need a clean finish. DIY is riskier when code compliance or a polished result matters.
